blocks.text:
To: Barbara Hall
Cc: David Sherman, Jeffrey Ochoa
The pay file came through, thank you, and it opens without trouble. That covers what Jeffrey Ochoa needs for the salary-increase side, so he can start there while I work the rest.

The one piece still open is the withdrawal detail. The contribution history you sent is complete, but the file does not separate a member who left and took a refund from one who left the balance in the fund, and that distinction is exactly what the termination experience turns on. If your system can export the withdrawal transactions with a reason code, that would settle it cleanly for the Estes Group study.
Send it whenever it is convenient, and I will reconcile it against the census the same day, so we can close the {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} data and move to the tabulation.
